page.description: Unraid editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A storage-focused NAS system that boots from a USB flash device and pools mixed-size disks without RAID, with Docker containers and virtual machines on top.
pros: Mixed disk sizes in one array; a failed disk only loses its own data.
Boots from a USB flash device, leaving all internal disks for storage.
Docker and virtual machines managed from the web interface.
cons: Requires a licence for the array after the trial.
The release images are ZIP archives and carry MD5 sums only.
The boot device is the licence dongle: lose it and the licence is re-registered.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Unraid; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Unraid is written to a USB flash device with its own USB creator or by unpacking the release ZIP. The release channel publishes MD5 sums only, so ROMinit pins nothing.
